EFFECTIVE DATE. This Act takes effect January 1, 2 2027. 3 EXPLANATION 4 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 5 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 6 This bill relates to the national electrical code. The 7 bill adopts the international energy conservation code, 8 2009 edition, as the basis of the national electrical code 9 applicable in this state. The bill requires the electrical 10 examining board (board) to conduct an analysis of the change 11 in the total cost of the average home built after January 1, 12 2027, due to any changes to the national electrical code prior 13 to adopting any changes to the national electrical code. The 14 board shall submit the analysis for publication in the Iowa 15 administrative bulletin along with the notice of intended 16 action. 17 The bill requires the seller of a single-family dwelling 18 constructed on or after January 1, 2027, to inform the buyer of 19 the dwelling if the dwelling does not comply with the standards 20 of the international energy conservation code, 2024 edition, 21 published by the international code council. 22 The bill takes effect January 1, 2027. 23 -2- LSB 6878XC (2) 91 ss/ns 2/ 2
